name: Sleep Timer
description: Adds a theme-aware sleep timer to Jellyfin Web playback controls. Timers can pause playback or exit the current video.
overview: Pause or exit playback after a selected duration

versions.changelog: Counts only active playback time, freezes while paused, uses minute-only centered presets, and simplifies custom-duration focus across themes and mobile layouts.
Matched the native settings-row height, prevented overlapping panels, trapped focus in the active dialog, and improved mobile custom-duration input.
Matched Jellyfin's native one-line settings rows, fixed first-tap behavior and input initialization, and added a compact mobile bottom sheet.
Moved Sleep Timer into Jellyfin's native player settings menu, removed the fragile control-bar selector, and added client diagnostics.
Redesigned player UI with native Jellyfin theme inheritance, responsive layouts, and repository installation.
